11.03.2021 Mr. Hamid Nawaz, Advocate for the
body: C.M. No.300/2021 This is an application seeking permission to place additional documents on record. The same is allowed subject to all just and legal exceptions.

Main Case Respondent No.2 filed a suit against the petitioner which is pending adjudication before Dr. Muhammad Sohail Thaheem, Civil Judge 1 st Class (West), Islamabad. The petitioner seeks transfer of the referred suit on the basis that the learned Trial Court is proceeding with the matter in utter disregard to the settled principles of Qanoon-e-Shahadat and law by recording of evidence through Universal Serial Bus (USB) and taking a printout of the same.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner, inter alia, contended that in the matter the learned Trial Court has recorded the evidence through USB and taking printout of the same and treating the same as an affidavit and examination-in-chief which is not tenable.
3. Learned counsel for respondent No.2, at the very outset, submitted that he has no objection to transfer of the matter provided the same be decided expeditiously.

4. In view of the above contentions of the parties, the instant petition is allowed and the learned Senior Civil Judge (West), Islamabad is directed to transfer the case titled “Haider Ali Daud v. Crown Agents” pending in the aforementioned Court to any other Court of competent jurisdiction in District West, Islamabad.
